original.encoding: concatenate indexed base64 text with whitespace removed; decode base64; gunzip; parse JSON

occurrenceStorage.indexFormula: SHA256 of every lexically ordered JSON tuple followed by LF; tuples include path,pointer,anchor,locale,hash; categories remain separate
occurrenceStorage.currentStorage: Replay all original categories from immutable archive; independently traverse ALL current source bytes; mapping exceptions retain every changed, added, moved or removed key. Per-source indexes authenticate the entire replay, never a sample.

mapping.unchangedRule: For every category and positional address absent from exceptions, compare every tuple including anchor and exact UTF-8 hash; emit originalKey -> identical currentKey. No range, sample or count-only acceptance.
